title: Operator Manual, Mine Resistant Ambush Protected All Terrain Vehicle (M-ATV), M1240/M1240A1/M1245
locator: cover page, page 1; Florida DMS mirror of the LOGSA release 08-12, pages 1-99
archive_ref: Florida Department of Management Services, MRAP information page, LOGSA release 08-12, 99 pages
licence: US Army technical manual. The cover carries DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT C: distribution authorized to US Government agencies and their contractors, proprietary information. It also carries an Oshkosh Corporation copyright release statement for the July 2012 COTS manual. The held copy is the public Florida DMS mirror.
note: Held tier-2 operator manual for the Oshkosh M-ATV M1240. It publishes identity, curb weight and gross weight, the Caterpillar C-7 rating of 370 hp as a maximum, the Allison 3500 SP automatic transmission and the tyre size code 395/85R20. It does not publish operating weight, net power, tyre width, tyre diameter or ground clearance. The held copy is on disk under data/vehicle/sources/ and its digest matches the registry entry.
